name: statusline-hud
description: Live session HUD: context, rate-limit pace, per-request and per-turn cost, cache countdown and miss detection, compaction advisor, dashboard pane and a budget tool for the model; leaves out what Desktop already shows

display.title: Where to show the HUD
display.description: band: multi-row band above the prompt; status: one pinned line; both

density.title: Band density
density.description: full: six rows (tokens, last request, compaction advisor, env); compact: two rows

cacheTtl.title: Prompt cache TTL
cacheTtl.description: auto follows Claude Code's rules (env vars, then 1h on a subscription within plan usage, else 5m); set it if you use the promptCacheTtl setting

budgetUsd.title: Session budget (USD)
budgetUsd.description: Toast once and turn the cost red when the session passes it; 0 turns it off

alerts.title: Toast alerts
alerts.description: Context 80/90%, rate-limit pace, cache about to go cold, budget

turnCost.title: Turn cost
turnCost.description: Show what the running turn has cost beside the spinner, and each finished turn's cost on its closing line
